title: Bicycle description
prompt: What did the writer say about the new bicycle?
hint: Give a short sentence mentioning its color and speed, like 'It is red and very fast.'
sample: It is red and very fast.

ja.prompt: 書き手は新しい自転車について何と言っていますか？
ja.hint: 色と速さを含む短い文で答えましょう。例：「赤くてとても速いです。」
ja.sample: 赤くてとても速いです。

local.prompt: What did the writer say about the new bicycle?
local.hint: Give a short sentence mentioning its color and speed, like 'It is red and very fast.'
local.sample: It is red and very fast.

title: Holiday activities
prompt: What did the writer do during the holidays?
hint: Say the two activities exactly as in the letter: visiting the park and reading many books.
sample: Visited the park and read many books.

ja.prompt: 休暇中に書き手は何をしましたか？
ja.hint: 手紙と同じように、公園に行ったこととたくさん本を読んだことを書きましょう。
ja.sample: 公園に行き、たくさん本を読みました。

local.prompt: What did the writer do during the holidays?
